What's your return and refund policy?
Our return and refund policy is designed to make the process as straightforward as possible:
Return Window: You have 21 days from the date of delivery to return your items.
Condition of Items: Items must be in their original condition – unworn, unwashed, and with tags still attached. Footwear should not have been worn outdoors.
Return Process: Once you’ve registered your return through our returns portal, we ask that the item(s) are posted back to us within 5 days.
Refund Processing: Once your return arrives at our warehouse, we aim to process it within 10 days. After approval, your refund will be issued to your original payment method within 3–5 business days. You’ll receive an email confirmation once the refund has been processed.
Special Cases: For hygiene reasons, boxers can only be returned if they are unworn, unwashed, and in their original packaging with seals intact.
Please ensure your parcel is securely packaged and retain proof of postage until your return is processed. If you'd like to read the full details, you can find our returns policy here.
Let us know if you have any further questions!
